description: This file implements webhook handling for Zalo integration, including request processing, rate limiting, replay detection, and security checks.

methods.name: clearZaloWebhookSecurityStateForTest
methods.description: Resets internal state for testing purposes, clearing rate limiter, recent events, and anomaly tracker.

methods.name: getZaloWebhookRateLimitStateSizeForTest
methods.description: Returns the current size of the rate limiter state for testing.

methods.name: getZaloWebhookStatusCounterSizeForTest
methods.description: Returns the current size of the webhook anomaly tracker for testing.

methods.name: registerZaloWebhookTarget
methods.description: Registers a Zalo webhook target with optional route configuration and returns an unregister function.

methods.name: handleZaloWebhookRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming webhook requests, performs security checks, rate limiting, replay detection, and invokes the update handler.
